# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 19

**1** Jesus said: "Blessed [маkаріос] is the one who came into being [шооп] before coming into being [шооп].

**2** If you become my disciples and hear my words, these stones will minister [дікон] to you.

**3** For you have five [іт] trees [шн] in Paradise [парадеісос] that do not move in summer [шеіт] or in winter [хеіх], and their leaves [хив] do not fall.

**4** Whoever knows them will not taste death [мою]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *шооп*: to be, to exist; "came into being before coming into being" — the pre-existent self; one's divine origin before incarnation
- *дікон*: to serve, minister; Greek loan-word διακονεῖν — the stones will serve as bread/spiritual nourishment
- *парадеісос*: Paradise; Greek loan-word παράδεισος (from Persian)
- *іт шн*: five trees; what these five trees are is debated; possibly the five elements of the spiritual world, or five divine attributes
- *шеіт / хеіх*: summer / winter; the trees are not subject to seasonal change — permanence
- *хив*: leaves; they do not fall — ever-green, eternal
- "Will not taste death" — third echo of Saying 1's promise (cf. Sayings 1, 18)

---
